description: Text that pops in one word at a time instead of fading in as a single block — for beats, emphasis, or narration-synced callouts. When content.text is word-for-word identical to the scene's narration, each word pops at the real moment it's spoken (from TTS/WhisperX timing); otherwise falls back to an even stagger that auto-compresses to always resolve before the asset's exit.

staggerFrames.description: fallback: target frames between word starts when narration-sync isn't used; auto-shrunk to fit the timing budget

wordPopScale.description: overshoot scale each word pops past on the way in

useNarrationTiming.description: When true (default) and content.text exactly matches the scene's narration text, pop each word at its real spoken time instead of an even stagger. Set false to force the stagger even when the text matches.

highlighter.description: Optional inline highlighter stroke that sweeps across the rendered text glyphs in step with the asset's active window. Omit or set null to render the text without a marker. When enabled (highlighter.enabled === true) the sweep behaves like the standalone TextHighlight asset: a colored band animates left-to-right (or right-to-left with direction:'left') over the text, or a thin underline when mode:'underline'.

enabled.description: presence of the highlighter block alone does NOT enable it — set true to draw the marker

color.description: raw hex color (#RRGGBB). Resolved by the framework's color-token resolver like any 'color'-named style key, so a theme token (e.g. 'accentWarm') is also accepted and resolved to a hex at pass 1.

colorToken.description: explicit theme color token name; takes precedence over 'color' when both are set

mode.description: band: filled marker over the text (default). underline: thin stroke beneath the text.

height.description: band height in px (band mode only). Default 32.

barThickness.description: underline thickness in px (underline mode only). Default 4.

opacity.description: marker opacity 0..1, multiplied by the host asset's enter/exit envelope. Default 0.75.

blur.description: gaussian blur in px on the band (band mode only). Default 4.

sweepStartFraction.description: where in the active window the sweep begins, as a fraction. Default 0.

sweepDurationFraction.description: sweep length as a fraction of the active window. Default 0.7.
